description: Projects UK pension drawdown month by month: the pot after any upfront tax-free cash, first-year net income after an estimate of UK or Scottish income tax, the age the pot runs out (if it does) and the final balance. The user's State Pension forecast is an input; it is never inferred. All fields are required; amounts in GBP, rates in percent per year.

age.description: Starting age; does not establish pension access; whole years.

endAge.description: End of projection; must exceed age; whole years.

growth.description: Nominal annual investment return, percent before fees

include_projection.description: Also return annual cash-flow rows (default false: a compact summary).

increaseWithdrawals.description: Increase withdrawals once per year with the entered inflation.

monthlyWithdrawal.description: Requested gross withdrawal, GBP per month

otherIncome.description: Other taxable income, GBP per year in today's money

remainingAllowance.description: Confirmed remaining standard lump sum allowance, GBP

statePension.description: User-supplied State Pension forecast, GBP per year in today's money; never inferred

statePensionAge.description: User-supplied pension payment start age; whole years.

takeTaxFreeCash.description: Remove upfront tax-free cash from invested capital. That cash is not spent or reinvested by this model.

name: calculate_uk_pension_drawdown
title: UK pension drawdown projection
